metadata.description: ISO/IEC 27002:2022, ISO/IEC 27005, ISO 22301, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 31000, and ISO 20000 controls mapped to DORA requirements

controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.description: A set of policies for information security shall be defined, approved by management, published and communicated to employees and relevant external parties.

controls.title: Review of the policies for information security
controls.description: The policies for information security shall be reviewed at planned intervals or if significant changes occur.

controls.title: Segregation of duties
controls.description: Duties and areas of responsibility shall be segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of the organization's assets.

controls.title: Management responsibilities
controls.description: Management shall require all employees, contractors and third-party users to apply information security in accordance with the established policies and procedures of the organization.

controls.title: Contact with authorities
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities shall be maintained.

controls.title: Contact with special interest groups
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations shall be maintained.

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.description: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected, analyzed and used to inform information security risk management decisions.

controls.title: Information security in project management
controls.description: Information security shall be integrated into project management.

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.description: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, shall be developed and maintained.

controls.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.description: Rules for the acceptable use and procedures for handling information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented and implemented.

controls.title: Return of assets
controls.description: All employees, contractors and third-party users shall return all of the organization's assets in their possession upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement.

controls.title: Classification of information
controls.description: Information shall be classified according to the information security requirements of the organization based on legal requirements, value, criticality and sensitivity to unauthorized disclosure or modification.

controls.title: Labelling of information
controls.description: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.description: Information transfer policies, procedures and controls shall be in place to protect the transfer of information through the use of all types of communication facilities.

controls.title: Access control
controls.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements.

controls.title: Identity management
controls.description: The full life cycle of identities shall be managed.

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.description: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process.

controls.title: Access rights
controls.description: Access rights shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on access control.

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.description: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of supplier's products or services.

controls.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.description: Relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier that may access, process, store, communicate, or provide an IT infrastructure component for, the organization's information.

controls.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.description: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.

controls.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.description: Organizations shall regularly monitor, review, audit and manage changes to supplier information security practices and service delivery.

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.description: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services shall be established in accordance with the organization's information security requirements.

controls.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.description: Processes and procedures shall be established and maintained to ensure a quick, effective and orderly response to information security incidents.

controls.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
controls.description: Information security events shall be assessed and it shall be decided if they are to be classified as information security incidents.

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.description: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.

controls.title: Learning from information security incidents
controls.description: Knowledge gained from analyzing and resolving information security incidents shall be used to reduce the likelihood or impact of future incidents.

controls.title: Collection of evidence
controls.description: The organization shall establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of information that can serve as evidence.

controls.title: Information security during disruption
controls.description: The organization shall plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.description: ICT continuity shall be planned, implemented, maintained and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT risk requirements.

controls.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.description: All relevant legislative, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements related to information security and the organization's approach to meet these requirements shall be explicitly identified, documented and kept up to date.

controls.title: Intellectual property rights
controls.description: Appropriate procedures shall be implemented to ensure compliance with legislative, regulatory and contractual requirements related to intellectual property rights.

controls.title: Protection of records
controls.description: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access and unauthorized release, in accordance with legislative, regulatory, contractual and business requirements.

controls.title: Privacy and protection of PII
controls.description: Privacy and protection of personally identifiable information (PII) shall be ensured as required in applicable legislation and regulations where applicable.

controls.title: Independent review of information security
controls.description: The organization's approach to managing information security and its implementation (i.e. control objectives, controls, policies, processes and procedures for information security) shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals, or when significant changes occur.

controls.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
controls.description: Compliance with the organization's information security policies, topic-specific policies, rules and standards shall be regularly reviewed.

controls.title: Documented operating procedures
controls.description: Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and made available to all personnel who need them.

controls.title: Screening
controls.description: Background verification checks on all candidates for employment, contractors and third-party users shall be carried out in accordance with relevant legislation, regulations, ethics and contractual requirements and shall be proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed and the perceived risks.

controls.title: Terms and conditions of employment
controls.description: The contractual agreements with employees, contractors and third-party users shall state their and the organization's responsibilities for information security.

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.description: All employees of the organization and, where relevant, contractors and third-party users shall receive appropriate awareness, education and training and regular updates in organizational policies and procedures, as relevant for their job function.

controls.title: Disciplinary process
controls.description: A formal disciplinary process for employees who have committed an information security breach shall be established.

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.description: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, enforced and communicated to relevant personnel.

controls.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.description: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organization's needs for the protection of information shall be identified, documented, regularly reviewed and signed by personnel.

controls.title: Remote working
controls.description: Information security policy and supporting security measures shall be implemented to protect information accessed, processed or stored at remote working sites.

controls.title: Information security event reporting
controls.description: Information security events shall be reported through appropriate management channels as quickly as possible.

controls.title: Physical security perimeters
controls.description: Physical security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain either sensitive or critical information and information processing facilities.

controls.title: Physical entry
controls.description: Physical entry controls shall be designed and applied.

controls.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.description: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities shall be designed and applied.

controls.title: Physical security monitoring
controls.description: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.

controls.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.description: Protection against physical and environmental threats, such as natural disasters, malicious attack or accidents shall be designed and applied.

controls.title: Working in secure areas
controls.description: Guidelines for working in secure areas shall be designed and applied.

controls.title: Clear desk and clear screen
controls.description: Clear desk and clear screen policies and procedures shall be defined and adopted taking into account the information security risks and the legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements.

controls.title: Equipment siting and protection
controls.description: Equipment shall be sited and protected to reduce the risks from environmental threats and hazards, and opportunities for unauthorized access.

controls.title: Security of assets off-premises
controls.description: Security shall be applied to off-premises assets, taking into account the different risks of working outside the organization's premises.

controls.title: Storage media
controls.description: Storage media shall be managed throughout their life cycle in accordance with the topic-specific policy on the use, handling and storage of assets.

controls.title: Supporting utilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

controls.title: Cabling security
controls.description: Power and telecommunications cabling carrying data or supporting information services shall be protected from interception, interference or damage.

controls.title: Maintenance
controls.description: Equipment shall be correctly maintained to ensure its continued availability and integrity.

controls.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.description: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.

controls.title: User endpoint devices
controls.description: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices shall be protected.

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.

controls.title: Information access restriction
controls.description: Access to information and other associated assets shall be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control.

controls.title: Access to source code
controls.description: Read and write access to source code, development tools and software libraries shall be appropriately managed.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.description: Secure authentication methods shall be used to control access to systems, applications and information.

controls.title: Capacity management
controls.description: The use of resources shall be monitored, tuned and projections made of future capacity requirements to ensure the required system performance.

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.description: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems being used shall be obtained in a timely fashion, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities evaluated, and appropriate measures taken to address the associated risk.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.description: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.

controls.title: Information deletion
controls.description: Information stored in information systems, devices or any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required.

controls.title: Data masking
controls.description: Data masking shall be used in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on access control and the business requirements, taking into account applicable legislation and regulations.

controls.title: Data leakage prevention
controls.description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.

controls.title: Information backup
controls.description: Backup copies of information, software and systems shall be maintained, along with the business continuity and disaster recovery plans.

controls.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.

controls.title: Logging
controls.description: Logging facilities and log information shall be protected against tampering and unauthorized access.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.description: Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behavior and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.

controls.title: Clock synchronization
controls.description: The clocks of all relevant information processing systems within an organization or security domain shall be synchronized to a single reference time source.

controls.title: Use of privileged utility programs
controls.description: The use of utility programs that might be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.

controls.title: Installation of software on operational systems
controls.description: Procedures and measures shall be implemented to securely install software on operational systems.

controls.title: Network security
controls.description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.

controls.title: Security of network services
controls.description: Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services shall be identified, implemented and monitored.

controls.title: Segregation of networks
controls.description: Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated on networks.

controls.title: Web filtering
controls.description: Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.description: Cryptographic controls shall be used in accordance with all applicable laws, regulations and standards.

controls.title: Secure development life cycle
controls.description: Rules for the development of software and systems shall be established and applied to developments within the organization.

controls.title: Application security requirements
controls.description: Information security requirements shall be identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.

controls.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.description: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system development activities.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.description: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.description: Security testing shall be performed during development and acceptance of systems, applications and infrastructure components.

controls.title: Outsourced development
controls.description: The organization shall direct, monitor, review and audit the development activities carried out by external parties.

controls.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
controls.description: Development, test and production environments shall be separated and managed.

controls.title: Change management
controls.description: Changes to information processing facilities and systems shall be subject to change management.

controls.title: Test information
controls.description: Test information shall be selected appropriately, protected and managed.

controls.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.description: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems shall be planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.

controls.title: Information security risk management framework
controls.description: Establish, implement, maintain and continually improve an information security risk management framework.

controls.title: Risk identification
controls.description: Identify information security risks by identifying threats, vulnerabilities and impacts on assets.

controls.title: Risk analysis
controls.description: Analyze information security risks to determine the likelihood of occurrence and potential impact.

controls.title: Risk evaluation
controls.description: Evaluate information security risks to determine which risks need treatment and their priority.

controls.title: Risk treatment
controls.description: Select and implement appropriate risk treatment options to address information security risks.

controls.title: Risk acceptance
controls.description: Residual risks shall be formally accepted by risk owners.

controls.title: Risk communication and consultation
controls.description: Information security risks and risk treatment decisions shall be communicated and consulted with relevant stakeholders.

controls.title: Risk monitoring and review
controls.description: Information security risks shall be monitored and reviewed on an ongoing basis to identify changes in the risk context.

controls.title: Business continuity policy
controls.description: The organization shall establish, implement and maintain a business continuity policy that is appropriate to the purpose of the organization.

controls.title: Business continuity objectives
controls.description: The organization shall establish business continuity objectives at relevant functions and levels.

controls.title: Business impact analysis
controls.description: The organization shall conduct business impact analysis to determine the impact of disruption on its activities.

controls.title: Risk assessment for business continuity
controls.description: The organization shall identify and assess risks that could cause disruption to its activities.

controls.title: Business continuity strategies and solutions
controls.description: The organization shall determine and select business continuity strategies and solutions.

controls.title: Business continuity plans
controls.description: The organization shall establish, implement and maintain business continuity plans.

controls.title: Business continuity exercises and testing
controls.description: The organization shall exercise and test its business continuity procedures to ensure they are effective.

controls.title: Shared responsibility matrix
controls.description: The cloud service provider and customer shall agree on and document a shared responsibility matrix that clearly defines the responsibilities for information security controls.

controls.title: Removal of customer assets
controls.description: The cloud service provider shall ensure that customer assets are removed from the cloud service provider's systems when requested by the customer or when the service is terminated.

controls.title: Return, transfer or disposal of customer assets
controls.description: The cloud service provider shall return, transfer or dispose of customer assets in accordance with agreed terms and conditions.

controls.title: Segregation in virtual computing environments
controls.description: The cloud service provider shall ensure that virtual computing environments are segregated to prevent unauthorized access to customer assets.

controls.title: Virtual machine hardening
controls.description: The cloud service provider shall implement appropriate hardening measures for virtual machines.

controls.title: Administrative operations and procedures
controls.description: The cloud service provider shall document and implement administrative operations and procedures for the cloud service.

controls.title: Monitoring of cloud services
controls.description: The cloud service provider shall monitor the security of cloud services and report security events to customers.

controls.title: Consent and choice
controls.description: The cloud service provider acting as a PII processor shall only process PII in accordance with the customer's instructions and the customer's consent choices.

controls.title: Purpose limitation and specification
controls.description: The cloud service provider acting as a PII processor shall process PII only for the purposes specified by the customer.

controls.title: Collection limitation
controls.description: The cloud service provider acting as a PII processor shall collect only the PII that is necessary for the specified purposes.

controls.title: PII retention and disposal
controls.description: The cloud service provider acting as a PII processor shall retain PII only for as long as necessary to fulfill the specified purposes.

controls.title: Disclosure to third parties
controls.description: The cloud service provider acting as a PII processor shall not disclose PII to third parties except as specified by the customer or required by law.

controls.title: Security of processing
controls.description: The cloud service provider acting as a PII processor shall implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect PII.

controls.title: Data breach notification
controls.description: The cloud service provider acting as a PII processor shall notify the customer of any data breach affecting PII without undue delay.

controls.title: Risk management framework
controls.description: The organization shall establish, implement and maintain a risk management framework that provides the foundation and organizational arrangements for designing, implementing, monitoring, reviewing and continually improving risk management.

controls.title: Risk management policy
controls.description: The organization shall establish a risk management policy that clearly states its objectives and commitment to risk management.

controls.title: Integration of risk management
controls.description: The organization shall integrate risk management into all organizational activities.

controls.title: Risk assessment process
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain a risk assessment process that includes risk identification, risk analysis and risk evaluation.

controls.title: Risk treatment
controls.description: The organization shall select and implement risk treatment options to address risks.

controls.title: Monitoring and review
controls.description: The organization shall monitor and review the risk management framework, process and activities to ensure their effectiveness.

controls.title: Service management system
controls.description: The organization shall establish, implement, maintain and continually improve a service management system.

controls.title: Service level management
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain service level agreements and monitor service performance against agreed service levels.

controls.title: Service continuity and availability management
controls.description: The organization shall plan, implement and maintain service continuity and availability management to ensure services meet agreed availability and continuity requirements.

controls.title: Capacity management
controls.description: The organization shall plan, implement and maintain capacity management to ensure adequate capacity is available to meet service requirements.

controls.title: Information security management
controls.description: The organization shall plan, implement and maintain information security management to ensure information security risks are managed.

controls.title: Incident management
controls.description: The organization shall plan, implement and maintain incident management to restore normal service operation as quickly as possible.

controls.title: Problem management
controls.description: The organization shall plan, implement and maintain problem management to prevent incidents and minimize the impact of incidents that cannot be prevented.

controls.title: Change management
controls.description: The organization shall plan, implement and maintain change management to ensure changes are assessed, approved, implemented and reviewed in a controlled manner.

controls.title: Supplier management
controls.description: The organization shall plan, implement and maintain supplier management to ensure suppliers and their services are managed effectively.
